usage: wtune post [-h]
                  {inventory,extract,plot,sounding,tc,compare,preview,report,recipe,cf3d,vapor-bundle,custom,brief,check,fetch,fetch-era5}
                  ...

positional arguments:
  {inventory,extract,plot,sounding,tc,compare,preview,report,recipe,cf3d,vapor-bundle,custom,brief,check,fetch,fetch-era5}
    inventory           domains/times/grid/variables/missing-frame summary
    extract             wrf-python diagnostics -> points CSV or box NetCDF
    plot                filled-contour maps on lat/lon, one file per time
    sounding            MetPy Skew-T at the nearest grid column
    tc                  TC track (TempestExtremes) + ATCF a-deck vs. b-deck
                        (MET tc_pairs/tc_stat/tc_rmw)
    compare             verify a STRICT change did not move the answer
    preview             before the run: the figures post will draw, the t=0
                        state and the observations to compare with, in
                        <project>/post/preview/
    report              collect PNGs/CSVs in a dir into one self-contained
                        HTML
    recipe              case-type-driven standard figure set + HTML report
                        (decision 0057), plus optional --every/--times time
                        series, change maps and animations (decision 0058)
    cf3d                CF-1.8 NetCDF on pressure levels and a regular lon-lat
                        grid (Met.3D/ParaView), wrf_d0N_pl_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.nc
                        under OUT/cf3d/d0N/
    vapor-bundle        ready-to-copy NCAR VAPOR bundle (wrfout frames hard-
                        linked, vapor_render.py, README.md, bundle.json) under
                        OUT/vapor/d0N/ -- VAPOR itself runs on an x86_64/macOS
                        workstation
    custom              run every analysis/*.py script in a project (decision
                        0058 section 2), collect their figures/tables into one
                        HTML report
    brief               decision 0078 stage 2: write POST_DIR/brief.json --
                        case, runs, checked observations, drawn/missing
                        figures with their questions, key numbers -- for the
                        agent that reviews a recipe
    check               decision 0078 stage 5: check the agent's
                        POST_DIR/review.json and assessment.md (sections,
                        citations, numbers against the cited CSVs); exit 1 on
                        an error
    fetch               download observation/reanalysis data into a project's
                        input/ (login node: compute nodes have no internet)
    fetch-era5          alias of `fetch era5`

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

--srun (any subcommand): run it as one exclusive compute-node job step (srun
-N1 --exclusive -t 120), excluding head and the project's exclude_nodes;
--srun-minutes N changes that time limit

help-predict.stdout:
usage: wtune predict [-h] [--namelist NAMELIST] --nodes NODES
                     [--config CONFIG] [--ranks RANKS] [--omp OMP] [--nx NX]
                     [--ny NY] [--numtiles NUMTILES] [--dist {block,cyclic}]
                     [--probe PROBE] [--probe-rsl PROBE_RSL]
                     [--case-name CASE_NAME] [--calibration CALIBRATION]
                     [--io-form {2,11,14}] [--io-target {nfs,local}]
                     [--include-io] [--iofields-dir IOFIELDS_DIR]
                     [--json JSON]
                     case_dir

positional arguments:
  case_dir              directory with namelist.input (+ optional
                        wrfinput_d0N/wrfbdy_d0N)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --namelist NAMELIST   explicit namelist.input path (default:
                        <case_dir>/namelist.input)
  --nodes NODES         number of nodes
  --config CONFIG       JSON blob or path: {ranks,omp,nx,ny,numtiles}
  --ranks RANKS         total MPI ranks (default nx*ny)
  --omp OMP             OMP threads per rank (default 1)
  --nx NX               nproc_x
  --ny NY               nproc_y
  --numtiles NUMTILES   numtiles (default 1)
  --dist {block,cyclic}
                        srun/mpirun rank distribution (block or cyclic; NOT
                        defaulted -- if omitted and --config has no 'dist',
                        the launch line prints dist=UNKNOWN and omits --rank-
                        by rather than guessing)
  --probe PROBE         strict_campaign ledger CSV (repeatable)
  --probe-rsl PROBE_RSL
                        path to a probe run's rsl.error.0000 (repeatable);
                        measures r_rad (and, when --probe gives no matching
                        ledger row, s_normal) from the probe's own d01 step
                        timings instead of the hard-coded r_rad default (see
                        measure_rad_from_rsl -- ASSUMES the probe window has
                        no mid-run history/restart writes)
  --case-name CASE_NAME
                        the case's ledger identity (case_base in --probe's
                        CSV), when it differs from case_dir's own basename
                        (default: case_dir's basename) -- e.g. a case whose
                        prep dir is /nfs/data/wrf/doi4-lafe2017 but whose
                        ledger case_base is 'lafe'; without this, --probe rows
                        for that case silently fail to match and prediction
                        falls back to no_probe_fallback
  --calibration CALIBRATION
                        calibration JSON (default: the machine's, built-in
                        machine/calibration/scc.json)
  --io-form {2,11,14}   override io_form_history (default: read from namelist)
  --io-target {nfs,local}
                        write target (default nfs; local is UNMEASURED)
  --include-io          add the history I/O estimate to TOTAL and its range
                        (off by default: the write rate is not predictable
                        enough, see build_prediction)
  --iofields-dir IOFIELDS_DIR
                        directory holding the real iofields_filename field-
                        list file(s) (default: case_dir); used to size field-
                        subset aux streams exactly
  --json JSON           also write the full prediction as JSON to this path

help-predict-rebuild.stdout:
usage: wtune predict-rebuild [-h] --nodes NODES --nx NX --ny NY
                             [--numtiles NUMTILES] [--omp OMP] [--ranks RANKS]
                             [--forcing {era5,auto}] [--spinup-min SPINUP_MIN]
                             [--max-points MAX_POINTS]
                             [--points-by {time,cost-indicators}]
                             [--indicator-sources INDICATOR_SOURCES]
                             [--measure-steps MEASURE_STEPS] [--rain-snow]
                             [--io-probe] [--no-io-probe] [--out OUT]
                             [--project PROJECT]
                             [--max-wait-hours MAX_WAIT_HOURS] [--dry-run]
                             case_dir

Whole-run wall-time prediction from rebuilt segments (decision 0054's final
architecture).

positional arguments:
  case_dir

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --nodes NODES
  --nx NX
  --ny NY
  --numtiles NUMTILES
  --omp OMP
  --ranks RANKS         default nx*ny
  --forcing {era5,auto}
                        era5: ARCO-ERA5 with cloud water/ice, 1 h (default);
                        auto: GFS/RDA/... chain
  --spinup-min SPINUP_MIN
                        default 10 with era5 (short window, 2026-09-28), 60
                        with auto
  --max-points MAX_POINTS
  --points-by {time,cost-indicators}
                        decision 0060: place points by sun/time (default) or
                        by a weather cost proxy from --indicator-sources; also
                        reports stratified/regression totals
  --indicator-sources INDICATOR_SOURCES
                        comma list, ordered fallback (default
                        case_forcing,era5,gfs,stage4,mrms)
  --measure-steps MEASURE_STEPS
                        steps measured after spin-up: an integer >= stepra+1,
                        'short' for max(30, stepra+10) (default with era5), or
                        'long' for max(30, 2*stepra) (default with auto)
  --rain-snow           era5 only: add rain/snow from the 137-level store
                        (optional; ~+1 pp on zhengzhou, within rerun noise)
  --io-probe            time one history frame (+ one restart if the case
                        writes restarts) at the end of the last point's
                        segment (default on)
  --no-io-probe
  --out OUT             default ./wtune-rebuild-<case>-<utc>, or
                        <project>/predict/<id>/ when --project (or
                        $WTUNE_PROJECT / a project.yaml above cwd) resolves
                        and --out is not given (decision 0058; never inside
                        CASE_DIR)
  --project PROJECT     project dir (decision 0058) -- see --out
  --max-wait-hours MAX_WAIT_HOURS
                        wall-clock cap including queueing (default 24); the 4
                        h budget counts only time with a segment running
  --dry-run             print the plan, submit nothing

help-run.stdout:
usage: wtune run [-h] [--nodes NODES] [--nx NX] [--ny NY]
                 [--numtiles NUMTILES] [--omp OMP] [--wall-limit WALL_LIMIT]
                 [--segment-minutes SEGMENT_MINUTES] [--stop-at STOP_AT]
                 [--prediction PREDICTION] [--tune-report TUNE_REPORT]
                 [--restart-io-form {14,2}] [--io {adios2,netcdf}]
                 [--cfl-rescue] [--resume N] [--checkpoint-minutes M]
                 [--sidecar] [--compress-history] [--wrfda-forecast-only]
                 [--out OUT] [--project PROJECT] [--dry-run]
                 [--wrf-tree WRF_TREE] [--env-source ENV_SOURCE]
                 [--campaign-dir CAMPAIGN_DIR] [--sacct-cmd SACCT_CMD]
                 [--poll-interval POLL_INTERVAL] [--stall-minutes M]
                 [--thompson-cache] [--no-space-check]
                 [case_dir]

wtune run -- segmented WRF executor with restart hand-offs (`wtune run`).

positional arguments:
  case_dir              default: the project's case/ (then the newest
                        tune/*/tune_report.json is used unless --tune-report
                        or --nodes is given)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --nodes NODES         required unless --tune-report names a winner layout
                        (flags override it)
  --nx NX
  --ny NY
  --numtiles NUMTILES   default: tune report, else 1
  --omp OMP             default: tune report, else 1
  --wall-limit WALL_LIMIT
                        HH:MM:SS per segment job
  --segment-minutes SEGMENT_MINUTES
  --stop-at STOP_AT     YYYY-MM-DD_HH:MM:SS (on a whole time step)
  --prediction PREDICTION
                        pred_rebuild.json (wtune predict-rebuild)
  --tune-report TUNE_REPORT
                        predicted-mode tune_report.json: per segment the
                        lowest-predicted candidate is run
  --restart-io-form {14,2}
  --io {adios2,netcdf}  adios2 (default, 2026-10-03 decision): every stream --
                        history, restart, input, boundary, aux inputs -- is
                        ADIOS2 (io_form 14); netCDF inputs are converted once
                        into the project's tune cache <project>/input/bp-
                        cache/<case>/<key>/ (shared with wtune tune; no
                        project: OUT/_bp_inputs/) and linked as <name>.bp.
                        netcdf: LEGACY escape hatch -- the case's own
                        io_form_* are kept (restart still per --restart-io-
                        form)
  --cfl-rescue          re-run a CFL/NaN-failed segment once with 0.75 dt
                        (marks PHYSICS-GRAY). This is the ONLY user-pre-
                        authorized exception to decision 0056's advisory-only
                        rule for solution-changing knobs -- without it, a
                        CFL/NaN failure stops and writes advice (recommended
                        time_step + a segment.advice.namelist.input) instead
                        of resubmitting anything.
  --resume N            auto-resume an infrastructure-failed segment job from
                        its latest valid restart, at most N times per run
                        (default 1; 0 disables)
  --checkpoint-minutes M
                        restart every M model minutes for --resume, when the
                        case's own restart_interval puts none inside a
                        segment. Default auto: the smallest multiple of the
                        input record step >= run length / 8 (only with
                        --resume > 0); 0 writes none
  --sidecar             while a segment job runs, record each valid restart
                        and convert finished history frames to netCDF in the
                        `wtune post` cache, on the job's idle cores
  --compress-history    --sidecar, and each converted history frame replaces
                        its BP directory (zlib netCDF, about 4x smaller,
                        checked against the BP first; on a full node one core
                        is shared at the lowest priority); of WTune's own
                        restarts only the newest valid set is kept, none once
                        the run has succeeded
  --wrfda-forecast-only
                        acknowledge that this WRFDA case is run as wrf.exe
                        forecast segments only: WTune does NOT run DA cycles
                        (obsproc/da_wrfvar/da_update_bc). Without it, a WRFDA
                        case is refused.
  --out OUT             required unless --project (or $WTUNE_PROJECT / a
                        project.yaml above cwd) resolves, in which case it
                        defaults to <project>/runs/<id>/ (decision 0058)
  --project PROJECT     project dir (decision 0058) -- see --out
  --dry-run
  --wrf-tree WRF_TREE   default $WRF_TREE (run/ files are linked by the job
                        too)
  --env-source ENV_SOURCE
  --campaign-dir CAMPAIGN_DIR
  --sacct-cmd SACCT_CMD
  --poll-interval POLL_INTERVAL
  --stall-minutes M     cancel a running segment job whose rsl.error.0000 has
                        not changed for M minutes and stop the run (0
                        disables; default 20)

help-tune.stdout:
usage: wtune tune [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--site SITE] [--minutes MINUTES]
                  [--nodes NODES] [--node-objective {time,cost,knee}]
                  [--deadline-minutes DEADLINE_MINUTES]
                  [--min-efficiency MIN_EFFICIENCY]
                  [--sweep-budget-frac SWEEP_BUDGET_FRAC]
                  [--hotspot-fill {on,off}] [--node-seeds {geometric,all}]
                  [--cores-per-node-options CORES_PER_NODE_OPTIONS]
                  [--pipeline {full}] [--max-queue-hours MAX_QUEUE_HOURS]
                  [--no-space-check] [--no-node-preflight] [-O0] [-O1] [-O2]
                  [-O3] [--precision PRECISION] [--level {0,1,2,3}]
                  [--stop-if-short] [--physics-advice] [--keep-frames]
                  [--physics-max-candidates PHYSICS_MAX_CANDIDATES]
                  [--node-finalists NODE_FINALISTS]
                  [--nodes-policy {cap,knee,min}] [--max-nodes MAX_NODES]
                  [--out OUT] [--project PROJECT] [--steps STEPS]
                  [--confirm-reps CONFIRM_REPS] [--restart-io-form {14,2}]
                  [--max-points MAX_POINTS]
                  [--points-by {time,cost-indicators}] [--seed SEED]
                  [--kappa KAPPA] [--cores-per-node CORES_PER_NODE]
                  [--hardware-id HARDWARE_ID] [--env-source ENV_SOURCE]
                  [--sbatch-script SBATCH_SCRIPT] [--ledger-dir LEDGER_DIR]
                  [--sacct-cmd SACCT_CMD] [--poll-interval POLL_INTERVAL]
                  [case]

positional arguments:
  case                  registered campaign/cases.json case id; required here
                        or via --config's 'case' key

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       wtune config YAML file: search-space restrictions +
                        budget/probe/prediction defaults (wtune/config.py);
                        CLI flags given explicitly still override it, which
                        overrides this module's own built-in defaults
  --site SITE           campaign/sites/<site>.sh (default: the machine's,
                        built-in scc)
  --minutes MINUTES     required here or via --config's budget.minutes
  --nodes NODES         N = fixed node count; 'search' (DEFAULT) = measure the
                        ANCHOR at each legal node count, choose N by --node-
                        objective, then tune at the finalist N; 'auto' =
                        uncalibrated efficiency proxy (--nodes-policy), no
                        measurement. (a --config budget.nodes also overrides
                        the default)
  --node-objective {time,cost,knee}
                        --nodes search: time = fastest (smallest N within
                        noise), cost = fewest node-hours (within --deadline-
                        minutes), knee = largest N with efficiency >= --min-
                        efficiency (default: time)
  --deadline-minutes DEADLINE_MINUTES
                        --node-objective cost: whole-run wall-time limit
                        (minutes)
  --min-efficiency MIN_EFFICIENCY
                        --node-objective knee: efficiency threshold (default
                        0.70)
  --sweep-budget-frac SWEEP_BUDGET_FRAC
                        --nodes search: share of --minutes the node sweep may
                        use; once spent, larger N are skipped ('sweep budget
                        cap') so the finalists keep budget (default 0.4, or
                        --config's budget.sweep_budget_frac)
  --hotspot-fill {on,off}
                        --nodes search: measure untried N near the best one in
                        the nodes a sweep wave leaves idle, when no longer
                        than the wave (default on, or --config's
                        budget.hotspot_fill)
  --node-seeds {geometric,all}
                        --nodes search: 'geometric' (DEFAULT) = 1, 2, 4, ...
                        and max_nodes, early stop upward, then refine; 'all' =
                        every legal N, no early stop (or --config's
                        budget.node_seeds)
  --cores-per-node-options CORES_PER_NODE_OPTIONS
                        --nodes search: comma list of cores per node to
                        measure at the finalist node counts (the rest of the
                        node idles). Default derived from the hardware core
                        count C: C, C-2, round(C*8/9), round(C*2/3), C/2 (72
                        -> 72,70,64,48,36); layouts that are not legal are
                        skipped. '--cores-per-node-options 72' disables the
                        dimension
  --pipeline {full}     full = -O3 (kept for compatibility): one pass --
                        layout search (node, cores/node, ranks, threads,
                        decomposition, tiles), whole-run prediction from
                        rebuilt points, physics advice (decision 0059)
  --max-queue-hours MAX_QUEUE_HOURS
                        --pipeline full: safety cap on the accumulated queue-
                        only wait (hours, default 6); queue wait is not
                        charged to --minutes, but past this the run stops and
                        reports
  --no-space-check      submit even when converting the inputs to BP does not
                        fit the space writable at the BP cache (GPFS quota or
                        free space)
  --no-node-preflight   skip the node health pre-flight (sinfo states + one
                        1-minute srun probe per node checking $HOME, the case
                        dir, wtune-src and wrf.exe); by default failing nodes
                        are excluded from every sbatch and max_nodes is capped
                        at the healthy node count
  -O0                   effort level 0: no jobs: cold-start predict + proxy
                        layout (layout search effort + physics advice; the
                        prediction points come from the case type)
  -O1                   effort level 1: one t0 wave over N in {1,2,4,8,max
                        healthy} (layout search effort + physics advice; the
                        prediction points come from the case type)
  -O2                   effort level 2: O1 + refinement, cores/node, sampled
                        round0 at the winner (layout search effort + physics
                        advice; the prediction points come from the case type)
  -O3                   effort level 3: DEFAULT, full layout search: every
                        legal N (coarse-to-fine), cores/node, ranks x omp, nx
                        x ny, numtiles at the finalists + confirm reps (layout
                        search effort + physics advice; the prediction points
                        come from the case type)
  --precision PRECISION
                        whole-run wall time needed to +-N% of the run (e.g.
                        10%) or +-MIN minutes (e.g. 15); default 10%, at least
                        2 min: the case type decides how many prediction
                        points that takes
                        (wtune.cost_drivers.plan_points_for_case)
  --level {0,1,2,3}     same as -O<level>; selects the one-pass pipeline
                        (default level when only --pipeline full is given: 3).
                        The estimated tuning time of every level is printed
                        before anything runs; --minutes is an optional hard
                        cap
  --stop-if-short       -O levels: when the whole run is shorter than the
                        estimated tuning time, step down to the highest level
                        whose estimate fits (never below O1). OFF by default:
                        the layout search is not cut short
  --physics-advice      -O3: also run phase 3, the physics advice (opt-in, not
                        part of the default run)
  --keep-frames         --pipeline full: keep the phase-2/3 window-frame .nc
                        files after the fidelity gate (default: delete them,
                        keeping the gate json/csv)
  --physics-max-candidates PHYSICS_MAX_CANDIDATES
                        --pipeline full: physics candidates tried in phase 3
                        (default 3)
  --node-finalists NODE_FINALISTS
                        --nodes search: how many node counts get the full
                        round0/adaptive/confirm search (default 2)
  --nodes-policy {cap,knee,min}
                        how --nodes auto picks a node count from the
                        (uncalibrated) profile: min=smallest legal,
                        cap=largest legal within --max-nodes, knee=stop
                        doubling once marginal speedup drops below 1.5x
                        (default: 'knee', or --config's budget.nodes_policy)
  --max-nodes MAX_NODES
                        default: 13 (or --config's budget.max_nodes)
  --out OUT
  --project PROJECT     project dir (decision 0058): when given (or via
                        $WTUNE_PROJECT / a project.yaml above cwd) and --out
                        is not, defaults --out to <project>/tune/<id>/ instead
                        of $HOME/wtune-runs/tune/<case>. Does not otherwise
                        change this command's behaviour.
  --steps STEPS         default: 20 (or --config's probe.steps)
  --confirm-reps CONFIRM_REPS
                        default: 2 (or --config's probe.confirm_reps)
  --restart-io-form {14,2}
                        io_form of the point jobs' shared restart
                        (RANKING_RESTART_IO_FORM); default 14 (ADIOS2), or
                        --config's probe.restart_io_form
  --max-points MAX_POINTS
                        probe.max_points override
  --points-by {time,cost-indicators}
                        probe.points_by override (decision 0060): place the
                        prediction points by sun/time (default) or by a
                        weather cost proxy (wtune.cost_drivers; sources from
                        probe.indicator_sources)
  --seed SEED
  --kappa KAPPA
  --cores-per-node CORES_PER_NODE
  --hardware-id HARDWARE_ID
  --env-source ENV_SOURCE
  --sbatch-script SBATCH_SCRIPT
  --ledger-dir LEDGER_DIR
                        where the probes write their ledger CSVs and run
                        directories (default: <project>/probes in a project,
                        else $WTUNE_CAMPAIGN_OUT or $HOME/wtune-runs/campaign)
  --sacct-cmd SACCT_CMD
  --poll-interval POLL_INTERVAL
